Android audio output is limited to 192 kHz, so the output sample rate is fixed at 176.4 kHz.

DSD 以 DoP 原樣送給 DAC，不轉成 PCM；上面的增益與輸出取樣率、播: DSD goes to the DAC as DoP, unchanged, with no PCM conversion. The gain and output sample rate above and the player volume do not apply; set the volume on the DAC or amplifier. The device must accept the 24-bit DoP rate (176.4 kHz for DSD64, 352.8 kHz for DSD128, 705.6 kHz for DSD256); otherwise that track is converted to PCM automatically. Only stereo DSD64, DSD128 and DSD256 are supported.

DSD 檔直接送到 USB 音訊裝置，不轉成 PCM；上面的增益與輸出取樣率、播: DSD files go to the USB audio device unchanged, with no PCM conversion. The gain and output sample rate above and the player volume do not apply; set the volume on the audio device or amplifier. Only stereo DSD64, DSD128 and DSD256 in DSF and WavPack-DSD files are supported; the device must offer the matching sample rate, otherwise that track is converted to PCM automatically.
